title: Path of Exile 2 0.5 Series Patch Timeline — What Changed and Where to Start
summary: The 0.5 series entry point: current version, how 0.5.0 to 0.5.4e relate, which pages are already re-verified, and the best starting page for returning players.
description: A navigation and relationship page for the 0.5 series. It does not duplicate each detail page; it links to them and states status.

sections.title: Current version in 30 seconds
paragraphs: The latest published patch in the 0.5 series is 0.5.4e. The current gameplay baseline is 0.5.4, with 0.5.4b, 0.5.4d and 0.5.4e as follow-up patches.
0.5.0 was the big content update; 0.5.1 and 0.5.2 added Atlas and Endgame changes, and 0.5.3 was a single Guild Stash fix folded into this timeline.
Returning players should start with the 0.5.0 overview, then jump to the specific 0.5.x page that touches their content.

versions.summary: Return of the Ancients: new League, Runes of Aldur systems, Endgame rework and new Ascendancies.
Additional Atlas passives, Lineage Support, new elemental passives and Runes QoL.
Endgame Atlas, Delirium, Runes of Aldur rewards, Catalyst and controller UI changes.
Single Guild Stash fix; folded into this timeline, no standalone page.
Runes of Aldur, Expedition Atlas, Liquid Verisium, Orb of Sacrifice and Pinnacle Boss changes.
Shader loading, Vulkan cache and VSync default changes.

sections.title: Major player impact across the series

cards.detail: The 0.5.0 overview explains the League, Runes of Aldur and Endgame rework you missed.
0.5.1 and 0.5.2 changed Atlas passives and Endgame rewards; old route Guides are stale.
Runes of Aldur, Liquid Verisium and Orb of Sacrifice need their own pages and re-checks.
Shader and VSync changes affect first-load feel; see the dedicated technical page.

sections.title: Returning player route
sections.oldText: Your pre-0.5 Build, Atlas and Endgame knowledge no longer matches the current client.
sections.newText: 0.5.0 overview -> your class Build page -> the 0.5.x page that touches your content -> the 0.5.4e technical page if performance feels off.

items.question: What is the current version?
answer: The latest published patch is 0.5.4e; the current gameplay baseline is 0.5.4 with follow-up patches.
This timeline links to each detail page rather than repeating them.

items.question: Where should a returning player start?
answer: Start with the 0.5.0 Return of the Ancients overview.
Then open the 0.5.x page that matches the content you care about: Atlas, Expedition, bosses, or performance.

issues.text: Several Boss and Expedition pages are still in reviewing/queued after 0.5.4b and the Hotfix chain.
0.5.3 had only a Guild Stash fix and is intentionally not a standalone page.
